newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London quiet, HSBC up.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London quiet, HSBC up.

text.p: Hong Kong shares in London saw quiet trading on Friday, with gains by HSBC Holdings propping up the market, traders said.
"The only reason the market is holding its own is that HSBC is HK$1-1/2 ahead of the Hong Kong close," one trader said, "If you took that out the market would probably be down around 20 points."
The Hang Seng London Reference Index was 2.44 points lower at 13,442.41, after the Hang Seng index in Hong Kong closed some 33.52 points firmer at 13,444.85.
-- Simon Gardner, London Newsroom + 44 171 542 4026 (c) Reuters Limited 1997
